long_biography.plain_text:
Bernd Kortüm transformed Norddeutsche Vermögen from a fund issuer into an operating shipping group. After first approaching ships through investment vehicles, he established Norddeutsche Reederei, acquired H. Schuldt in 2000 and later added Schlüter, building a substantial container-ship management operation.

His business outlook was formed through economics studies in Zurich, Frankfurt and Cologne, followed by a doctorate. He moved to Hamburg in 1975 and developed property funds alongside shipping finance, then expanded into commercial property and senior-care facilities. The company remembered his preference for long-term quality and a respectful culture; outside business, he supported disadvantaged children and seafarers.
